claims.statement: APOE epsilon2 allele confers reduced relative risk for late-onset Alzheimer disease compared to epsilon3/epsilon3 baseline.
claims.limitations: Composite finding requiring both rs429358 and rs7412; homozygosity for e2/e2 is also associated with type III hyperlipoproteinemia with variable penetrance.

claims.statement: APOE epsilon4 allele in homozygous (e4/e4) or heterozygous (e3/e4) configuration increases late-onset Alzheimer disease relative risk (~12-15x for e4/e4, ~3-4x for e3/e4 versus e3/e3 baseline).
claims.limitations: Requires phasing of both rs429358 and rs7412 to determine isoform; not a deterministic monogenic diagnostic test. Significant proportion of e4/e4 individuals do not develop dementia.

claims.statement: DPYD c.1905+1G>A (*2A) results in complete loss of dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase activity; heterozygous carriers require at least 50% initial fluoropyrimidine dose reduction, and homozygotes require complete avoidance or severe reduction.
claims.citation_label: Amstutz et al. 2018 Clin Pharmacol Ther
claims.limitations: Single-variant limitation: testing rs3918290 alone cannot rule out DPYD deficiency caused by *13 (rs55886062), c.2846A>T (rs67376798), or HapB3 (rs75017182). Full activity score requires comprehensive multi-variant panel.

claims.statement: PNPLA3 p.I148M (rs738409[G]) is strongly associated with hepatic steatosis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD/MASLD), and elevated liver transaminases across diverse ancestry groups.
claims.limitations: GWAS epidemiological association; ClinVar review status is 1-star (single submitter) because it is a common susceptibility allele rather than monogenic determinant. Effect is strongly modified by BMI, alcohol consumption, and metabolic factors.
